gloss: for personal use; for individual use

definitions.gloss: for personal use; for individual use
definitions.explanation: Intended for use by one person rather than shared, commercial, or institutional use. Commonly seen on product labels, forms, and regulations.

examples.japanese: これは{個人用|こじんよう}のロッカーです。
{個人用|こじんよう}のメールアドレスは{仕事|しごと}に{使|つか}わないでください。
examples.english: Please don't use your personal email address for work.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}は{個人用|こじんよう}にダウンロードできますが、{商用|しょうよう}{利用|りよう}は{禁止|きんし}されています。
examples.english: You can download this photo for personal use, but commercial use is prohibited.

notes:
Composed of {個人|こじん} (individual/personal) and {用|よう} (use/for). A very common label found on products, licenses, and services to indicate single-person use as opposed to shared or commercial use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人用|こじんよう}パソコン: personal computer
- {個人用|こじんよう}アカウント: personal account
- {個人用|こじんよう}{防護|ぼうご}{具|ぐ}: personal protective equipment

SIMILAR TERMS WITH 〜{用|よう}:
- {一般用|いっぱんよう}: for general use
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}: for commercial/business use
- {家庭用|かていよう}: for household use
- {共用|きょうよう}: for shared use
